neighbours.label: ' and' / ' but' right after a 'one'-quantified phrase, before the counterpart (as few as one, and...; one reason and another)
fire: They expected as few as one, and as many as fifty, visitors.
For one reason and another, the trip was cancelled.
Fans on one side and police on the other waited.
We will close one year and open the next with hope.
As little as one hour, and up to three, may be needed.
There was one rule and another for the rich.
Prices rose in one shop and fell in the other.
Over time one group and then the other took control.
quiet: They expected forty visitors and fifty journalists.
For reasons of cost, the trip was cancelled.
Fans on the street and police at the gate waited.
We will close the year and open presents with joy.
As little as an hour may be needed to finish.
There was a rule for the rich and the poor.
Prices rose in the shops and fell online.
Over time the group grew and took control.

notes: Card top: ' and' x13, ' but' x7 after 'one'. Probe: 'as few as one, and' 0.56, 'one reason and another' 0.75, 'one side and' 0.45; 'apples and pears' 0.03; but 'between one thing and another' 0.06 and 'one by one and' 0.08, so the context is not fully pinned down. Negative pole: ' then' in successions.
